propositions: Twelve near-duplicate CLI verbs (exists, format, check-ac, clarity-check, quality-check, tag, untag, get-file-impact, get-verify-commands, list-descendants, session-logs) must be consolidated into golden-path verbs (check, resolve, show, deps, list) with hard cutover and removal hints.
Removed spelling lookups must fail loudly with exit code 2 and a hint message directing users to the replacement verb, populated via a _REMOVED_SPELLINGS registry dict.

The resolve_cli handler signature must change from (argv, tracker) to (argv, tracker, repo_root) to support the --display flag folded from the deleted format verb, with the resolve route adapter flipping to argv_tracker_root.

The new check verb must unify three mutually exclusive modes (--ac, --clarity, default dispatch readiness) that delegate to their existing handlers with unchanged signatures (check_ac_cli, clarity_check_cli, quality_check_cli both 2-arg and 3-arg respectively).

The list verb must gain a --limit N option applying after sort_states, with recent_session_logs_state dropping its private sort to share one ordering rule (sort_states with -created descending, ticket_id tiebreak) across library, CLI, and MCP for row-for-row parity.

All 16 removed spellings (11 consolidated + 5 historical) must be validated in parametrized dispatch tests exiting 2 with the hint, and all replaced call sites in scripts, tests and documentation must use the new spellings or be allowlisted as library function names.
